newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines sees eight percent GNP growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Philippines sees eight percent GNP growth in 1997.

text.p: President Fidel Ramos said the Philippines could achieve an eight percent growth in its gross national product (GNP) by the end of 1997.

"The economy is bullish as ever. So maybe, we are capable of an eight percent economic growth next year," Ramos told guests at the presidential palace on Friday night, a palace news release said on Sunday.

The Philippines posted 7.1 percent GNP growth in the first half of this year against 5.6 percent in the same period last year. Government economists expect the GNP to grow between seven and 7.5 percent by the end of this year, the palace statement said.
